name: Slow Down
description: The target team's countdown runs at 2x (and yours at 0x) until they clear it.
clearance: Sing a full song in public.

name: Tourist Trap
description: The target team's countdown runs at 2x (and yours at 0x) until they clear it.
clearance: Take a selfie with a stranger.

name: Brain Freeze
description: The target team's countdown runs at 2x (and yours at 0x) until they clear it.

name: Duplicate
description: Duplicate another card in your hand.

name: Veto
description: Cancel a curse on your team.

name: Increase Hand Size
description: Your hand limit goes up by 1 for the rest of the game.

name: Steal
description: Take a random card from another team's hand.

name: Double Reward
description: Your next completed challenge gives double the time bonus and double the card draws.

name: Siphon Boost
description: Pick one of your active curses: you gain 2x from it until it is cleared.

name: Curse Two Teams
description: Pick one of your active curses and put it on a second team too.

name: Challenge Swap
description: Send one challenge on the board back to the pool; a random one replaces it.

name: Lock Challenge
description: Lock one challenge on the board so only your team can complete it.

name: Range Extension
description: Extend the range of one curse by double.

name: The Boogeyman
description: Upon taking a photo of another team, you take 30 minutes of their time. Elimination phase only.

name: Infinity
description: Make the range of one curse infinite, applies to anyone anywhere (note: the other team can always use the 30 minute veto).
